title: Vesuvius
description: PVP Modpack that uses VulkanMod for increased peformance.
body:
# Vesuvius

## About this Modpack
Vesuvius is a Minecraft PVP Modpack made to focus on pure performance and nothing else, so there are no aesthetic mods. This is a mix of VulkanMod compatible mods. These mods are the leading optimization mods used in the modern minecraft scene.

Cool stuff you can use with this:
- [Oratot's PVP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/oratotpvp)*
- [Theobald's Practice Bot](https://www.discord.gg/theobald)

Inspired off of: [Vulkanite](https://modrinth.com/modpack/vulkanite)

Versions past 1.21.5 will be released later because of me focusing on other things than this modpack.
